purpose: Defines how a propulsion/transit installation certificate expresses the bounded operating conditions under which return-to-service evidence remains valid. Route admission may not treat CERTIFIED as an unlimited capability claim.

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.role: Governing design intent for differentiated gravity sensitivity, miscalculation penalties, predictive safety sensing, emergency de-transit, and maturity-scaled safety engineering.

coreInvariant: A maintenance certificate is valid only inside the operating envelope for which its evidence was collected or analytically bounded.

scalarBandModel.pointRequest: A point request is represented by L_r=U_r=x_r.
scalarBandModel.safeguard: Partial overlap is not certification. If any portion of the requested interval lies outside the certified interval, the dimension blocks admission.

coupledConstraintModel.purpose: Supports coupled limits such as power-versus-cooling, acceleration-versus-payload, or simultaneous field-sector demand without pretending dimensions are independent.
coupledConstraintModel.safeguard: A coupled constraint is evaluated only when all referenced variables and compatible units are supplied. Missing variables remain UNRESOLVED.

dimensionRule.unitCompatibility: Certified and requested units must match exactly unless an explicit trusted conversion has already normalized them before evaluation.
dimensionRule.boundaryAdvisory: CONDITIONAL only when the certificate explicitly supplies advisoryMarginFraction and the request remains fully inside the certified band.

familySafeguards: Operating-envelope dimensions do not select FTL family.
PRECOMMIT families may certify timing/prediction/state envelopes without fabricating local FTL velocity.
Anchored portal systems may certify mouth power, synchronization, aperture/throat, admission, exit, clearance, and recovery envelopes rather than free-flight velocity.
Continuous projected-progress families may certify projected-progress demand only when the applicable family authority defines that quantity.
Environmental dimensions are certificate limits, not replacements for family-specific route physics. Passing an installation gravity/tidal limit does not by itself make a route safe.

raceTechnologySafeguards.arnock: Express ordinary envelope evidence through modular solid-state power/control, silicon timing, piezoelectric alignment/condition evidence, cooling, protected stores, and field/actuator modules. Do not substitute biological machinery by default.
raceTechnologySafeguards.zwleiMurrek: May express envelope evidence through bio-reactive power fluid, hydraulic vane authority, dielectric-fluid condition, conductive coolant, Navigation Current reference state, and sensor machinery while preserving unresolved consolidated FTL-family identity.

provenanceRule: Every envelope dimension must retain source, measurement/model status, epoch when relevant, units, and whether the bound is measured, inferred, manufacturer/design authority, post-refit certified, simulation-only, or unresolved.
